== Published English Original Virtual Set 5 wording ==
The surviving remastered sheet specifically dates this replacement to 14 September 2007. It replaces the explicit once-per-battle redraw wording with a during-battle just-drew condition and expressly cancels that destiny. It also retimes the optional Force loss to when battle destiny is drawn. The change in literal frequency wording does not independently establish unlimited redraws.
